propositions: rebar init silently creates an empty divergent orphan store when it cannot obtain the configured tickets branch because branch detection checks only local refs.
A shared tri-state remote-branch probe using git ls-remote --exit-code distinguishes advertised (0), reachable-absent (2), and unreachable/timeout, and is consumed by all four init consumers.
When the remote advertises the branch but a bounded fetch fails, init must return nonzero with remote/branch diagnostics and never create an orphan.
When the remote is unreachable or times out, init fails closed unless the explicit --force-new-store override or init_repo(force_new_store=True) keyword authorizes deliberate bootstrap.
The probe result is cached for a short TTL keyed by repo/remote/branch so one CLI invocation performs at most one probe, with monotonic-clock re-probe after TTL expiry.
The cold fetch retains its 300-second bound while the advertisement probe uses a separate short bound, both folding TimeoutExpired to return code 124.
